Trump meets Venezuela's interim leader at UN

U.S. President Donald Trump met with Venezuela's interim leader, Juan Guaidó, for the first time since the capture of Nicolás Maduro. The meeting took place at the United Nations. Trump highlighted the capture of Maduro and a subsequent oil deal with Venezuela.
